item.text:
Implemented Task 002 and committed it as `3c39cad7a9e7426aeeae9b7f3bb450a1379f3e10`.

Project pages now support task creation, saved completion toggles, and All/Open/Completed filtering. Tasks persist with their owning project across process restarts. Verified health, creation and title trimming, completion updates, restart persistence, and `git diff --check`; the working tree is clean.

Run with `npm start` (`PORT` defaults to 8080; set `DB_PATH` to choose the SQLite file).
